verdict.rationale: Mangopay docs show custom fraud-detection logic, dispute/chargeback handling, and webhook event notifications that could support risk monitoring, but there is no evidence of a per-sub-merchant risk dashboard, anomaly alerts across a seller portfolio, or explicit tools to pause payouts/offboard bad actors. missing for 10: portfolio-level risk dashboard per sub-merchant, anomaly/alerting system for sellers, payout-pause or offboarding workflow.
